concept.title: DITA architecture
concept.abstract: This chapter explains the DITA architecture model, focusing on the relationship between topics, maps, and content reuse mechanisms that enable modular, single-source documentation. It covers the structure and purpose of both book maps and DITA maps, including topic references, topic groups, topic heads, and key definitions, while demonstrating how content can be organized, reused, and published across multiple outputs. The chapter also presents map design principles, hierarchy rules, navigation strategies, and validation practices that support scalable information architecture, content governance, and efficient documentation management.
